_what: DIAGNOSTIC PROBE of sirilpy `analyse_image_from_file` against the values run_frame_qa.sh already records. MEASURES ONLY — nothing wired, no intake table built, no gate.
_verdict: NOT EQUIVALENT and NOT FASTER. Roundness agrees; star count and FWHM do not; the raw arm is disqualified outright.

scope.frames: first 12 of the set with both a record and a staged raw
scope.limit: one set, one night, 12 frames. Timing at n=12; register -2pass is a SEQUENCE operation and its per-frame cost need not scale as this.

what_the_record_actually_measures.finding: records.jsonl NAMES a raw (DSC_1265.NEF) but its numbers are NOT measured on that raw.
what_the_record_actually_measures.mechanism: run_frame_qa.sh:108 runs `convert c -debayer` -> `register c -2pass`, and the recorded metrics are parsed from the resulting `c_.seq` REGDATA by `inspect_stage.py reg --seq` (fields fwhm_px/wfwhm_px/round/bg16/nstars). The CODE PATH is what establishes this.
what_the_record_actually_measures.consequence: a one-arm comparison against the NEF confounds ESTIMATOR with SAMPLING, so two arms were run.
what_the_record_actually_measures._correction: An earlier wording here and in commit f702bad's message said the register LOG lines 'reproduce the recorded nstars/fwhm exactly'. That overstated the log evidence. The recorded values come from the .seq regdata, not from the printed `Found N ... (FWHM x)` lines; the star counts 1482/1463/1466 do all appear in the recorded set, but per-frame FWHM pairing was NOT verified to 3dp. The claim does not rest on it — the code path is decisive on its own, and the two arms corroborate it at 0.151x vs 0.855x.

arm_1_raw_nef.finding: loading a NEF gives the CFA MOSAIC, not a debayered image — channels=1.
arm_1_raw_nef.verdict: DISQUALIFIED as a drop-in: it finds ~15% of the recorded stars.

arm_2_debayered.verdict: roundness agrees to 0.7%; star count is ~14% low and FWHM ~17% low on IDENTICAL pixels.

the_gap_is_UNATTRIBUTED.ruled_out_channel: findstar on the same file reports channel #1 at 1482 stars / FWHM 2.695 — the recorded value — while the API reads 1271 / 2.229 on that same file.
the_gap_is_UNATTRIBUTED.ruled_out_persisted_state: setfindstar reads sigma=1.00 roundness=0.50 radius=5 convergence=1 relax=off profile=Gaussian, i.e. Siril's defaults, so the persisted preference is not the difference.
the_gap_is_UNATTRIBUTED.status: the API uses a different internal detection path from `findstar` at default settings on identical pixels. NOT attributed here.
the_gap_is_UNATTRIBUTED.discriminating_test: sweep setfindstar sigma/roundness and see whether any setting brings findstar onto the API's numbers; if none does, the paths differ in code, not in configuration.

the_quantity_trap_CONFIRMED.finding: ImageAnalysis carries NO background-level field at all. The two differ by ~7 orders of magnitude and are not the same quantity.
the_quantity_trap_CONFIRMED.consequence: the cloud signature's Z +4.05 floor is built on LEVEL. A drop-in would swap the quantity under the signature silently.

timing_per_frame_seconds.verdict: the API is ~2.2x SLOWER per frame than the step it would replace, and both routes still pay the debayer.

_reproduce.note: the .ssf are GENERATED with absolute paths and are deliberately NOT tracked — a machine-local path in a tracked file is the class CLAUDE.md's Environment section warns about. The bodies are recorded here instead.
_reproduce.arm_1: requires 1.4.0 / pyscript probe_analyse.py frames.txt arm_raw.json   (frames.txt = absolute paths to the 12 NEFs)
_reproduce.debayer: requires 1.2.0 / set16bits / setcompress 0 / setext fit / cd <src> / convert c -debayer -out=<deb>   (verbatim the convert run_frame_qa.sh:108 uses)
_reproduce.existing_route_timing: requires 1.2.0 / set16bits / setcompress 0 / setext fit / cd <deb> / register c -2pass -transf=homography -interp=lanczos4
_reproduce.channel_check: requires 1.2.0 / setext fit / cd <deb> / load c_00001 / findstar
_reproduce.derived_data: 1.7 GB of debayered FITS was built and deleted; only the records are kept.
